title.rendered: PAC Dine Out at MOD Pizza, 12/18

content.rendered: Please join us at the Sherwood MOD Pizza this Thursday, December 18th for this month’s PAC Dine Out. Mention Archer Glen at the time of your order and 25% of your order total will be donated by MOD Pizza to Archer Glen. If you place your order online, please use the fundraiser code MODGIVES25.
